doc: PROFILE.md 5.2: 'pdal translate f.las f.las now refuses. Exit status 255, the diagnostic `PDAL: Input and output filenames are equal and no --overwrite option was provided!`' -- the guard compares the filenames the command was given, so it fires for a LAZ pair too. The LAS read-back afterwards is what makes this case LAZ-specific: at 2.4.0 the same command truncates the file to 0 bytes and reports 'PDAL: Unexpected end of file.', so 2.5.0 is the only anchor where the file still reads back as 1000 points.
